Priya (Finance): Aptus Biotech reported a billing error on INV-2026-0621-7788 — they were charged twice for a large embeddings ingestion. Ticket SUP-5099. Asking for a refund + small promo for the inconvenience.

Jon (Support): Customer says they kicked an ingestion job and the UI re-submitted when it retried after a timeout. Job ids provided: ingest_2109 and ingest_2109_retry. They included logs and screenshots.

Rafael (Engineering): Quick usage check: `SELECT job_id, tokens FROM usage WHERE job_id IN ('ingest_2109','ingest_2109_retry');`
Results: ingest_2109 = 820,000 tokens; ingest_2109_retry = 815,400 tokens. Looks like duplicate processing.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0621-7788 total $8,140.00. Line item: embeddings-ingest charged twice at $4,070.00 each. Suggested adjustment code ADJ-8590.

Tara (Sales): Aptus is on a growing account, ~ $28k ARR. Recommend issuing a $4,070 refund and a $200 promo credit to keep relationship healthy. Non-recurring promo.

Priya (Finance): I approve a manual adjustment of $4,070 under ADJ-8590. Promo $200 good as a one-off. Please include memo: "duplicate ingestion refund + goodwill promo" and mark both entries non-recurring. @Rafael can you create the adjustment?

Rafael (Engineering): Will submit adjustment API call: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments {"invoice":"INV-2026-0621-7788","amount":-4070,"reason":"duplicate ingestion refund","code":"ADJ-8590"}` and attach job logs. Will also create promo PROMO-APTUS-200.

Jon (Support): Notified customer: "We've queued a $4,070 refund and applied a $200 promotional credit to your account. Expect refund in 3-5 business days." Customer replied with :thumbsup:. Ticket SUP-5099 updated.

Priya (Finance): Manual adjustment ADJ-8590 created and awaiting ledger posting. Promo PROMO-APTUS-200 generated. Will confirm once posted. :white_check_mark:

Billing Bot: ADJ-8590 posted to ledger on 2026-06-23. Invoice updated; PROMO-APTUS-200 applied. Customer notification email queued.
